return_semantics: Returns bytes written on success; negative error code on failure.
task_rules: Input must be non-empty ASCII decimal digits only ('0'..'9').
Parse as unsigned 32-bit decimal with overflow check.
Overflow is invalid when acc > 429496729 or (acc == 429496729 and digit > 5).
Write exactly 4 bytes little-endian parsed value to out_ptr on success.
